topic: A compilation of funny soccer edits involving AI-generated meme characters inserted into real match footage.

hook.first_frame: A person running outdoors in athletic shorts with three icons (bicycle, golf cart, car) overhead.

shots.shows: A man running next to a car, transitioning to a yellow hulk-like figure running.
Soccer players standing together on a pitch, edited to show one holding another's arm.
AI-generated image of two soccer players dressed as a groom in uniform and a bride in a wedding dress.
Soccer match clip where a player dribbles past a defender who falls down.
A child sitting on the floor in a decorated nursery room.
Soccer match clip with a high-flying kick challenge between players.
Two fighters in a cage fighting ring executing a flying kick.
Soccer player dribbling against a heavy player edited with an octopus lower body.
Soccer match goal sequence edited with a clown lying on the ground.

music.style: Upbeat remix or electronic meme beat

ending.last_frame: A soccer player kicking the ball while a clown lies on the pitch.

retention_tricks: Rapid cuts between surprising AI-edited sports moments
Unexpected visual transformations (e.g., players turning into a bride/groom, octopus, clown)
what_makes_it_work: Absurdist AI edits injected into real football footage
High-energy sync between music beat drops and visual changes
Surprise transformations that subvert viewer expectations
